lines: Scam Alert: Scammers Spoofing RIDOH State Phone Numbers

The Department of Health has gotten reports of scammers using Rhode Island State Government Phone numbers. If you receive a call from a RIDOH phone number and you are not sure if it is from our department, please hang up and call us back directly at 401-222-5960. We’re happy to assist you.
The Office of the Attorney General has great resources to help you identify scams: https://riag.ri.gov/scams

The Rhode Island Department of Health (RIDOH) licenses or certifies three different kinds of laboratories. These laboratories have different application and renewal requirements. For all license types, renewal notices are sent out about 60 days before the license expiration date.

RIDOH licenses clinical laboratories to protect the health, safety, and welfare of the public. (View license application .) Licenses are effective for 2 years and expire at the end of the calendar year. Clinical labs renew their licenses online .

RIDOH certifies analytical laboratories to test drinking water, wastewater, and environmental samples for lead and other contaminants. (View license application .) Licenses are effective for 1 year and expire on December 30 of each year. Analytical labs cannot renew their licenses online. Renewal notices are sent out about 60 days before the license expiration date.
Analytical Laboratory Licensing for Sampling and Testing Cannabis

The Cannabis Laboratory Licensing Program licenses analytical laboratories to collect and analyze cannabis products cultivated and/or manufactured by licensed cultivators, compassion centers, and producers. (View license application .) Licenses are effective for 1 year and expire on December 30 of each year. Analytical labs cannot renew their licenses online. Renewal notices are sent out about 60 days before the license expiration date. For more information on how to get licensed as a Cannabis Testing Laboratory, review this fact sheet for applicants .
